item.title: Amami Sea Turtle Nesting Season — Guide
item.description: The warm, clear seas and beaches of Amami Oshima and Kagoshima’s southern islands are important nesting grounds for sea turtles, and witnessing their life cycle is a moving wildlife experience. From around May to August, female sea turtles — including loggerhead and green turtles — return to the beaches where they were born to come ashore at night, dig nests in the sand and lay their eggs, before returning to the sea.
